Byte-identical copies of her files from Google Drive "youniverse-game-completed-release.zip" (Drive id 1fDvIpqkXOawi_frUGg7M5UbX5TwlMygg, 681,974 bytes; Drive also holds duplicate copies with ids starting 1qQ9eSBpx and 1Z3VpGKWv).
zip sha256: df4ee460cc5be364841b99b7fd52fa7efb5c1fa0f4b3a40693ed9cab7ae30fea
Only the import closure of the three game worlds, their stores/morph/renderer/WorldAdapter and her photo intake (photo/photoIngestion.js + pngDecoder.js, used to turn the chosen avatar into her visualIdentity) is copied (36 files + README/package.json + world/README.md). Not copied (still in the zip, unchanged): everything outside that closure, e.g. server.js, hub.js, public/, photo/imageTools.js + image_worker.py (Python), scripts/, test/ (her e2e suites, which pass on Node 22 against the zip), vendor/pure-synthia-automata, integration/.
Nothing here is edited. Browser use goes through an import map to ../youniverse-games-shims (node:fs/path/crypto/zlib + Buffer stand-ins, FILLED IN).
